mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy eases.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines over the prior 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 4.5% in a 3-month window signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE > 4.5 over the prior 3 months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in residential construction (HOUST) and real consumer spending (RSAFS) indicate broad demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as revenue expectations fall.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where both HOUST and RSAFS decline over the prior 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 110 in a 3-month window signals manufacturing slowdowns that reduce corporate profit growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO < 110 over the prior 3 months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained growth in real consumer spending (RSAFS) over the prior 6 months boosts corporate revenue expectations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where RSAFS increases over the prior 6 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production declining below 110 in a 3-month window indicates manufacturing weakness that reduces corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where INDPRO < 110 over the prior 3 months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Low unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%) creates wage pressures and inflation, prompting Federal Reserve tightening that results in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods where UNRATE < 4.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous federal funds rate decline (FEDFUNDS) and consumer inflation rise (CPIAUCSL) signal aggressive monetary easing amid inflation, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods where FEDFUNDS declines and CPIAUCSL rises over the prior 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.
